What we handle

If it's on your list, it's probably on ours. Here are the jobs homeowners, landlords, and small businesses call us for most.

Lighting and electrical

New fixtures, dead outlets, and upgrades installed safely and to code.

  • Light fixtures
  • Ceiling fans
  • Outlets and switches
  • GFCI protection
  • Lighting upgrades

Plumbing fixtures and repairs

Drips, clogs, and worn-out fixtures fixed before they turn into water damage.

  • Faucets
  • Toilets
  • Garbage disposals
  • Bidet seats
  • Leak repair
  • Shutoff valves and water lines

Doors, carpentry, and trim

Doors that stick, gaps that let in drafts, and trim that needs a careful hand.

  • Door adjustments and replacement
  • Hinges and locks
  • Smart locks
  • Weatherstripping
  • Trim and baseboards
  • Shelving

Drywall, paint, and flooring

Holes, cracks, and scuffs repaired so you can't tell where the damage was.

  • Drywall patching
  • Texture matching
  • Interior and exterior paint
  • Luxury vinyl plank
  • Laminate flooring

Exterior repairs

Protect the outside of your home from weather, rot, and wear.

  • Fascia and trim
  • Siding
  • Gutters
  • Fence repair
  • Deck repair
  • Paint and stain

Assembly and installation

Boxes in the garage? We build it, mount it, and haul off the packaging.

  • Furniture
  • Grills
  • Gazebos and pergolas
  • Sheds
  • TV mounting
  • Blinds
  • Shower doors
  • Appliance hookups

Rental and property maintenance

Turnovers, punch lists, and tenant requests handled quickly so units stay rent-ready.

  • Make-ready and turnovers
  • Punch lists
  • Smoke and CO detectors
  • Caulking and sealing
  • Routine maintenance

How it works

No guessing about when we'll show up or what it will cost.

  1. Tell us the jobCall, text, or send the form with a photo or two if you have them.
  2. Pick a timeWe confirm the service address and a visit time that works for you.
  3. Approve the priceYou get a clear price before any work starts. No surprise bills.
  4. Done and cleaned upWe protect your floors, finish the work, and leave the space clean.
